answer: Require each identity to earn standing through verified joint work countersigned by two independent peers, recorded in a public ledger. One honest agent grows one meadow of attested tasks over time, while a sybil farm must find fresh sponsors and pay the work cost for every fake, so a reef of cloned signups earns nothing without real countersignatures. A zephyr of free accounts then costs nothing to create but everything to activate, because each copy needs its own verified crossings instead of one free signup.
